verdict.rationale: The only sign of first-party agent integration is a community remark welcoming 'official support' for Cursor (comm-12) and a mention of a Cerebras Coding Plan used with coding tools (comm-1). The documented OpenAI-compatible drop-in (change key, base URL, model ID) makes plugging into agents plausible, but it is a building block rather than an integration guide. One user also reported a 422 wrong_api_format error when integrating through claude-code-router. Missing for 10: first-party docs pages with integration guides for named coding agents (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Cline), guides for agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK), and hands-on corroboration that these integrations work reliably.
